summary.text: Cindy Bruckner is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Democratic primary.
According to her campaign website, she spent more than two decades as a global creative director.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Bruckner says on her campaign website that she has owned property in Montana for over 35 years and has lived in the state full time for a decade.
She states that she worked for over two decades as a global creative director and earned a master's degree in applied psychology last year.

Her campaign site lists accessible housing and property tax relief among her priorities, including a proposal that owners and landlords offer housing exclusively to locals for the first 30 days on the market and a cap on property taxes based on income.
